# focused

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modeFocused`](gmeow-modeFocused.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modeFocused>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Concentrated, goal-directed attention — wakefulness with attention narrowed onto a task or object, the opposite pole of [`gmeow:modeMindWandering`](gmeow-modeMindWandering.md). Typically carries a high [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessLevel.md); the human counterpart, by analogy, of a directed machine inference run.
